props.heading: Full Grooming Package
props.content:
FULL GROOMING PACKAGE

Our Full Grooming Package is the most comprehensive grooming service we offer, designed for cats who need thorough coat care, styling, or significant detangling and mat removal. This is our signature service for long-haired breeds, cats with neglected coats, and feline owners who want their cat to look and feel absolutely their best.

Lion Cut: The most popular feline styling option, the lion cut involves clipping the body short while leaving a full mane around the head and neck, fur on the lower legs (boots), and a pom on the tail tip. This cut is ideal for cats with severe matting, cats who overheat, or cats whose long coats are difficult for their owners to maintain between grooming sessions.

Teddy Bear Cut: A softer alternative to the lion cut, the teddy bear cut trims the coat to an even, medium length (about 1 inch) all over the body, giving the cat a plush, rounded appearance. This option works well for cats who mat easily but whose owners prefer a more natural look.

Breed-Specific Trim: For breeds like Persians, Himalayans, and Maine Coons, we offer breed-specific grooming that maintains the cat’s natural coat characteristics while keeping the fur manageable and healthy.

Short/Medium Coat: Starting at $75 Long Coat: Starting at $95 Lion Cut or Teddy Bear Cut: Starting at $110 Severe Mat Removal: Priced by condition (consult required)

Rates vary based on coat condition, size, and temperament. Contact us for a quote.

A full grooming session typically takes 1 to 2 hours, depending on the cat’s coat condition and the styling requested. For cats with severe matting or those requiring extensive detangling, we may recommend a two-session approach to minimize stress. Our groomers never rush — they work at your cat’s pace and take breaks as needed.

To help ensure the best possible grooming experience, we recommend bringing your cat in on an empty stomach (no food within 2 hours of the appointment) to reduce the risk of nausea during the bath. Let us know about any skin sensitivities, allergies, or behavioral concerns so we can tailor our approach accordingly.

Schedule your cat’s full grooming appointment today. Contact us online or call (949) 582-1732 .
